testOutput:
Success! Completed the audit on the authenticated demo account and visited all requested pages. Dashboard/login worked; /website redirected back to the dashboard state; /ai-receptionist rendered with content but indicated a dedicated phone number is required; /expenses, /automations, /inventory, /equipment, /whs, /files, /rebates, /calculators, and /payment-hub rendered with real app shells/content; /leads was blank after navigation. Payment Hub showed visible demo financial summaries and Stripe Connect state. Console/browser issues observed across the run included CSP violations for Google Analytics and a WebSocket handshake error (400) on the realtime connection.
Verification gaps:
Could not fully verify some pages beyond the initial rendered state because the recurring 'What You Missed' modal stayed present on many routes. The /equipment page was observed in a loading state before moving on. /leads remained blank, so no page-specific UI could be inspected there.

Minor issues:
Recurring 'What You Missed' overlay is intrusive across routes. Console logs show repeated analytics resource failures and WebSocket handshake errors, though the app otherwise remained usable.
